title: Geometrically Abelian Sections on Higher-Dimensional Varieties
summary: We investigate how much arithmetic information about a variety can be detected by sections of the geometrically abelian fundamental groups of sufficiently small open subvarieties. Over a \(p\)-adic field, such a section determines a rational point on the Albanese torsor, and, under a conjectural assumption, this point is represented by a \(0\)-cycle of degree \(1\) on the original variety if the variety has index \(1\).
